My Lighthouse score was 31.
Not on a side project. Not on a demo. On the production loan dashboard my team shipped to a banking client.
I did not know the score was 31 until a client executive shared a screenshot in a review meeting. The screenshot had one color on it. Red. Everything was red.
Two weeks later the same dashboard scored 97. Same features. Same data. Same API. I changed how the app loaded, how it rendered, and how it stayed out of the browser’s way.
Here are the 9 fixes, in the exact order I applied them, with the Lighthouse numbers after each one. Every fix is an Angular code change you can copy into your project today.
Understanding What Lighthouse Actually Measures
Before touching code, I needed to understand what the 31 was made of. Lighthouse scores five metrics, each with a different weight:
METRIC WEIGHT WHAT IT MEASURES
+---------------------+---------+-----------------------------------+
| Total Blocking Time | 30% | how long the main thread is |
| (TBT) | | blocked by JS during load |
